name: External Investigation Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the investigation reason, as published in an external investigation reason code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

RERE.name: Related Reference
RERE.definition: Related transaction reference is incorrect, incomplete or missing.

SVLV.name: Payment Service Level
SVLV.definition: Payment type service level is incorrect, incomplete or missing.

CAPU.name: Category Purpose
CAPU.definition: Payment type category purpose is incorrect, incomplete or missing.

REDT.name: Requested Execution Date
REDT.definition: Requested execution date is incorrect or missing.

AMNT.name: Amount
AMNT.definition: An amount element has triggered the investigation.

DTOR.name: Debtor
DTOR.definition: Further information pertaining to the debtor is requested.

DTAG.name: Debtor Agent
DTAG.definition: Further information pertaining to the debtor agent is requested.

IGRA.name: Instructing Reimbursement Agent
IGRA.definition: Further information pertaining to the instructing reimbursement agent is requested.

IDRA.name: Instructed Reimbursement Agent
IDRA.definition: Further information pertaining to the instructed reimbursement agent is requested.

TDRA.name: Third Reimbursement Agent
TDRA.definition: Further information pertaining to the third reimbursement agent is requested.

INAG.name: Intermediary Agent
INAG.definition: Further information pertaining to an intermediary agent is requested.

PYCC.name: Payment Clearing Channel
PYCC.definition: Payment type clearing channel is incorrect, incomplete or missing.

CTAG.name: Creditor Agent
CTAG.definition: Further information pertaining to the creditor agent is requested.

CTOR.name: Creditor
CTOR.definition: Further information pertaining to the creditor is requested.

REIN.name: Remittance Information
REIN.definition: Remittance information is incorrect, incomplete or missing.

PYPU.name: Payment Purpose
PYPU.definition: Transaction payment purpose is incorrect, incomplete or missing.

CHBE.name: Charge Bearer
CHBE.definition: Further information pertaining to the charge bearer is requested.

INNA.name: Instruction For Next Agent
INNA.definition: Further information pertaining to the instruction for next agent is requested.

INCA.name: Instruction For Creditor Agent
INCA.definition: Further information pertaining to the instruction for creditor agent is requested.

STET.name: Statement Entry
STET.definition: Further information pertaining to a statement entry is requested.

SEAC.name: Settlement Account
SEAC.definition: Further information pertaining to the settlement account is requested.

CHIN.name: Charges Information
CHIN.definition: Further information pertaining to the charges information is requested.

ULTD.name: Ultimate Debtor
ULTD.definition: Further information pertaining to the ultimate debtor is requested.

ULTC.name: Ultimate Creditor
ULTC.definition: Further information pertaining to the ultimate creditor is requested.

PURP.name: Purpose
PURP.definition: Further information pertaining to the purpose is requested.

INPA.name: Initiating Party
INPA.definition: Further information pertaining to the initiating party is requested.

REGR.name: Regulatory Reporting
REGR.definition: Regulatory reporting is incomplete or missing.

TAXD.name: Tax
TAXD.definition: Tax data is incomplete or missing.

FCCI.name: Financial Crime Compliance
FCCI.definition: Investigation relates to financial crimes compliance.

FWTR.name: Funds Transfer Regulation Or Wire Transfer Regulation
FWTR.definition: Investigation relates to funds transfer regulation or wire transfer regulation.

AMLI.name: Anti Money Laundering
AMLI.definition: Request message relates to anti-money laundering.

RQPR.name: Request Party Relationship
RQPR.definition: Clarification over a party relationship is requested.

RQVD.name: Request Vessel Or Aircraft Details
RQVD.definition: Clarification over a vessel or aircraft is requested.

RQLD.name: Request Location Details
RQLD.definition: Clarification over location details is requested.

RQSG.name: Request Services Or Goods Details
RQSG.definition: Clarification over goods or services involved is requested.

RQED.name: Request Services Or Goods Exchange Date
RQED.definition: Clarification over when goods or services were exchanged is requested.

RQDO.name: Request Documentation
RQDO.definition: Documentation relating to the transaction is requested.

CHNP.name: Cheque Not Yet Paid
CHNP.definition: Cheque not yet paid despite being sent to agent.

NARR.name: Narrative
NARR.definition: See AdditionalRequestData element for additional information

UTAP.name: Unable To Apply By Creditor
UTAP.definition: A booked entry cannot be applied by the creditor.

CONR.name: Creditor Agent Claim Cover Non Receipt
CONR.definition: Creditor agent claims non-receipt of cover or settlement.

PINC.name: Payment Initiation Not Confirmed
PINC.definition: Payment initiation has not been settled or confirmed.

RQVA.name: Request Value Date Adjustment
RQVA.definition: Revaluation of an entry is requested.

RQUF.name: Request Use Of Funds
RQUF.definition: Use of funds on an entry is requested.

RQDA.name: Request Debit Authorisation
RQDA.definition: Debit authorisation on an entry is requested.

RQCH.name: Request Related To Charges
RQCH.definition: Investigation relating to charges that have been taken or are unpaid.
